CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content organization/presentation/access was found.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates) and organization/presentation metadata (origin) are both explicitly given for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition linked to the same content's organization/presentation/access was stated.

C.rationale: The report enumerates identified contents (coloured cell sets) with named attributes (red/blue) for specific referents and times.

D.rationale: Content coordinates are listed separately from origin/status metadata, distinguishing identification from presentation/status.

O.rationale: The report specifies presentation/organization via origin metadata and explicit spatial sets describing how content is organized.
